descripcion_geo: Strategic city at the Wadi Ara pass that connects the Sharon plain with the Jezreel valley; one of the most important archaeological sites in the world.
importancia_estrategica: Crossroads of the armies of the ancient world; In the Apocalypse its Greek name (Armageddon) is the scene of the final battle.

historias.titulo: The Battle of Megiddo: Pharaoh Thutmose III
historias.descripcion: Pharaoh Thutmose III defeats the Canaanite coalition at Megiddo; first detailed documented battle in history.

historias.titulo: The death of King Josiah in Megiddo
historias.descripcion: The reformer king Josiah goes out to meet Pharaoh Necho in Megiddo and is mortally wounded by an archer.

historias.titulo: Megiddo in the prophecies and the Apocalypse
historias.descripcion: The Apocalypse uses the Greek name of Megiddo ('Armageddon') as the location of the final eschatological battle.

personajes.descripcion: Died in Megiddo; His death was mourned like that of no other king: he became a paradigm of the suffering of the just.
With Deborah, he defeated Sisera's army in the waters of Megiddo.
The song of Deborah mentions the kings of Canaan who fought in Megiddo.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Megiddo: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: Armageddon: the battle of the ages

judaismo.descripcion: Megiddo was the scene of so many decisive battles that its name became a symbol of the place of the definitive confrontation between good and evil.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Megiddo was the scene of so many decisive battles that its name became a symbol of the place of the definitive confrontation between good and evil.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Apocalypse calls 'Armageddon' (mountain Megiddo) the place of the final battle between God and the forces of evil (Rev 16:16).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Apocalypse calls 'Armageddon' (mountain Megiddo) the place of the final battle between God and the forces of evil (Rev 16:16).
